name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: A bar of menus in a hairline control, its open trigger on the gray wash pill, each menu the dashboard's framed menu.
usage: An editor or tool with many commands grouped by kind (the playground's File, View and Run). Keep menu names to one word, put frequent commands first, and show their shortcuts. For one menu use DropdownMenu; for page navigation use NavigationMenu or the sidebar.
avoid: A single menu in a bar
Animating the move from one menu to the next

reference.source: context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/menu.tsx (the menus); src/components/ui/tabs.tsx (the gray wash pill)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.

exampleFiles.content:
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Copy, Download, Play, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

import {
  Menubar,
  MenubarCheckboxItem,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarLabel,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarRadioGroup,
  MenubarRadioItem,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarSub,
  MenubarSubContent,
  MenubarSubTrigger,
  MenubarTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/menubar";

function Bar({ defaultValue }: { defaultValue?: string }) {
  const [wrap, setWrap] = React.useState(true);
  const [format, setFormat] = React.useState("json");
  return (
    <Menubar defaultValue={defaultValue}>
      <MenubarMenu value="request">
        <MenubarTrigger>Request</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>
            <Play strokeWidth={1.5} />
            Run
            <MenubarShortcut>⌘↵</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>
            <RotateCcw strokeWidth={1.5} />
            Reset parameters
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarSeparator />
          <MenubarSub>
            <MenubarSubTrigger>Copy as</MenubarSubTrigger>
            <MenubarSubContent>
              <MenubarItem>cURL</MenubarItem>
              <MenubarItem>TypeScript</MenubarItem>
              <MenubarItem>Python</MenubarItem>
            </MenubarSubContent>
          </MenubarSub>
          <MenubarSeparator />
          <MenubarItem variant="destructive">Clear history</MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu value="view">
        <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarLabel>Response</MenubarLabel>
          <MenubarRadioGroup value={format} onValueChange={setFormat}>
            <MenubarRadioItem value="json">JSON</MenubarRadioItem>
            <MenubarRadioItem value="markdown">Markdown</MenubarRadioItem>
            <MenubarRadioItem value="html">HTML</MenubarRadioItem>
          </MenubarRadioGroup>
          <MenubarSeparator />
          <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={wrap} onCheckedChange={(on) => setWrap(on === true)}>
            Wrap long lines
          </MenubarCheckboxItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu value="export">
        <MenubarTrigger>Export</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>
            <Copy strokeWidth={1.5} />
            Copy response
            <MenubarShortcut>⌘C</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>
            <Download strokeWidth={1.5} />
            Download JSON
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem disabled>Download CSV (tables only)</MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
    </Menubar>
  );
}

export function Site() {
  return <Bar />;
}

export function Product() {
  return <Bar />;
}

export function Open() {
  return <Bar defaultValue="view" />;
}
